parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0519 result. It appears my previous 0.8518 was heavily contaminated by shard 10 leakage. To align with the team and find real improvements, I am switching to the 'honest' TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' baseline. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.08 on the clean 0-9 setup with DEPTH=6 and batch 262144.
parsed.description: Switching to honest TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' and testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR=0.08 to see if we can improve convergence on the clean baseline.
